visual_goal: Show one stock item carrying the car from appraisal to registration, with every arrow that leaves the platform crossing a dashed boundary into systems it does not control.
prompt: A wide illustration with one large dashed rounded boundary filling the center of the image, representing the platform. Inside the boundary, upper row left to right: a clipboard with a car outline labeled 'Appraisal', a large folder with a car outline labeled 'Stock item', and an advert card with a car photo labeled 'Advert'. Inside the boundary, lower row right to left: an envelope labeled 'Leads' and a signed contract labeled 'Deal'. Both 'Leads' and 'Deal' sit fully inside the dashed boundary. Outside the boundary, four systems: at the top a server box labeled 'DMS'; on the right a stack of generic web screens labeled 'Portals'; at the bottom right a building with columns labeled 'Register'; at the bottom left a gavel labeled 'Trade'. Blue arrows inside the boundary: 'Appraisal' to 'Stock item'; 'Stock item' to 'Advert'; 'Leads' to 'Deal'. Orange arrows crossing the boundary: from 'Advert' out to 'Portals' labeled 'desired state'; from 'Portals' back in to 'Leads' labeled 'enquiries'; from 'Deal' out to 'Register'; a double-headed arrow between 'Stock item' and 'DMS' labeled 'commands and receipts'; from 'Stock item' out to 'Trade' labeled 'exclusive right to sell'. These nine labels plus the four arrow labels are the only words in the image. Each label appears exactly once, directly below its icon; 'Portals' is written only once. 'Trade' sits fully outside the dashed boundary.
alt: Inside a dashed platform boundary, appraisal leads to a stock item and an advert, then leads and a deal; orange arrows cross the boundary to portals, the register, the DMS and trade.
